content:
Soojin Lee: ok shifting to post-launch follow-ups. we’ve got 72h of traffic + signups data now. need a plan for: (1) retargeting (2) webinar recording distro (3) nurture emails. can we align owners + dates today?

Ben Carter: yep. quick snapshot from Growth: benchmark landing page sessions up, conversion to signup decent, but big drop from “PDF download” -> “first API call”. we should run retargeting to push: quickstart + sample code + interactive table.

Tyler Benson: +1. also reminder: attribution is messy unless we standardize UTMs + HubSpot campaign tags. I can set the naming + make sure ads/email/webinar all roll into the same campaign object.

Noura El-Khoury: webinar recording is ready-ish. ops team has raw file + chat transcript. we need final edit (trim intro + fix slide 12 audio pop) and a landing page version w/ gated vs ungated decision.

Ethan Wallace: re: nurture, we can repurpose the “How we measured latency/$” section into a 2-email educational sequence. seen a couple replies saying “cool numbers but how do i know it matches my workload?” so we should lead w/ methodology + “how to reproduce for your prompts”.

Grace O'Connor: from SDR side: we’re getting inbound from mid-market/enterprise that wants a 20 min walkthrough + “send me the deck”. if marketing sends the recording + a 1-pager, we can route those as warm touches instead of cold sequences.

Camila Reyes: agree. also, keep claims conservative in retargeting creatives. don’t do “fastest” language. stick to “production inference economics” + “see results by region/model” + “read methodology”.

Ben Carter: retargeting proposal:
- audiences:
  1) visited benchmark page, no signup
  2) downloaded PDF, no signup
  3) signed up, no first API call within 48h
- channels: LinkedIn + X + Google (dev intent).
- creatives:
  A) “Interactive latency/$ table by region” (CTA: explore)
  B) “Webinar: how we benchmarked + what to replicate” (CTA: watch)
  C) “Quickstart: run your first prompt in 5 min” (CTA: start)
- frequency cap: 2/day, 14-day window.

Soojin Lee: love it. can we avoid any “competitor” framing in ads? legal will be twitchy.

Ben Carter: yeah. no competitor logos, no “vs”. all Redwood-first.

Tyler Benson: if we do remarketing, we need consistent UTMs:
`utm_campaign=benchmark_report_v1` and channel-specific `utm_source` (`linkedin`, `google`, `x`) + `utm_medium=paid_social` etc. I’ll drop a template.

Logan Wright: instrumentation note: benchmark page events are landing in analytics (filter_change, export_csv, cta_signup_click). we can build remarketing off “cta_signup_click but no signup complete” if we want (needs a little glue).

Ben Carter: that’d be amazing. can we get that into the next sprint, or is it already in?

Logan Wright: already capturing the events. audience building depends on ops + ad platform connectors. I can sync w/ Tyler.

Noura El-Khoury: webinar distro options:
1) ungated recording page (SEO + shareability)
2) gated (lead capture)
I’m leaning ungated since we already have the report gated-ish via PDF download, and we want dev trust.

Camila Reyes: +1 ungated. we can still add a sticky CTA on the recording page.

Ethan Wallace: can we also cut 3 short clips (30–45s) for social? e.g.
- “why latency/$ not tokens/sec”
- “how we handle variance / reruns”
- “how to replicate w/ your prompt mix”

Noura El-Khoury: yes. I’ll ask our editor to produce 3 clips + a pull-quote graphic. need final timestamps from whoever has notes.

Soojin Lee: I can send timestamps from rehearsal notes. also want an FAQ link under the video. ppl keep asking caching/batching question.

Ben Carter: nurture emails draft structure:
- Email 1 (D+2 after PDF download or webinar watch): “What latency/$ means (and what it doesn’t)” + link to methodology
- Email 2 (D+5): “Reproduce the benchmark on your prompts” + code snippet + docker runner mention
- Email 3 (D+9): “Choosing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private” + CTA to sizing call
Segmenting by persona (dev vs platform/security) would help but might be v2.

Grace O'Connor: if you can add a branch for “enterprise email domain + visited pricing/security pages”, SDRs will get better signal. even just a different CTA: “book a Dedicated sizing session”.

Tyler Benson: I can build the HubSpot workflow branches using:
- company size (Clearbit)
- page views (pricing, security, private deployment)
- form source (PDF download vs signup)
But we need final copy + CTA URLs by EOD tomorrow to hit next week.

Soojin Lee: ok timeline:
- Retargeting brief + creative copy: Ben draft by Thu
- UTMs + campaign tagging + workflows: Tyler by Fri
- Webinar final edit + ungated page draft: Noura by Fri
- Nurture email copy v1: Ethan + Ben by Mon
- SDR routing notes / talk track addendum: Grace to propose, Soojin to review

Camila Reyes: add a check: legal review on ad copy + email claims before launch. Sofia/Michael will want to see “no superlatives” + disclaimer language consistent.

Ben Carter: noted. I’ll keep copy factual: “see results” “learn methodology” “benchmark configs available” etc.

Ethan Wallace: I’ll make sure emails include a “results vary by workload; see methodology” line in the footer + link.

Noura El-Khoury: question: do we email the recording to everyone or only registrants?

Soojin Lee: both, but different framing.
- Registrants: “thanks for joining / here’s the recording + resources”
- Non-attendees (registrants): “sorry we missed you / 20-min version + timestamps”
- General list (bench visitors): “watch the walkthrough + how to replicate”

Tyler Benson: please don’t blast the general product list. segment to anyone who engaged with benchmark assets in last 30d + lookalike list for paid.

Ben Carter: +1. also we should A/B subject lines: “Benchmark walkthrough recording” vs “How we measured latency/$ (recording + code)”.

Logan Wright: if we need “webinar_watch” event on the page for retargeting, tell me what player we’re using. I can instrument on play + 25/50/90%.

Noura El-Khoury: likely Wistia. I’ll confirm once web publishes.

Grace O'Connor: can we also put a Calendly link for SE “benchmark replication consult” in the email? AEs are asking for an easy CTA.

Soojin Lee: yes but careful: don’t overpromise that they’ll match our numbers. language: “help you design a workload-fit PoC + interpret results”.

Camila Reyes: :thumbsup: keep it grounded.

Ben Carter: action items recap:
- Ben: retargeting brief + ad copy draft + audience definitions (Thu)
- Tyler: UTMs + HubSpot workflow branches + campaign tag + ensure ops reporting (Fri)
- Noura: webinar final edit + ungated page + 3 clips request (Fri)
- Ethan: nurture copy pass focusing on methodology + replication (Mon)
- Logan: coordinate player instrumentation w/ Noura/Tyler (next week)
- Grace: SDR routing / talk track addendum + Calendly CTA wording (Mon)

Soojin Lee: cool. I’ll set a 25-min working session tomorrow 10:30 to review ad/email claims before legal sees them.

Tyler Benson: dropping UTM template here for everyone:
`https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign=benchmark_report_v1&utm_content=creative_a`

Noura El-Khoury: perfect. will share recording link in this thread once the audio fix is done.

Camila Reyes: thanks all. keep momentum—this is where we turn attention into pipeline.
